pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against opening secondary or tertiary positions within 180 seconds or 2.0 ATR of a previous loss or in the direction of a liquidity wick.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe volume-weighted spread and order-book imbalance confirmation; reject all trades if ATR exceeds the 20-period median by >1.8x.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop-locks once floating profit hits +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric retention toward the +$30.00 target window.
